# Large-shortlist and text-selection fixtures

Copy `targets`, `repositories.json`, `shortlist.json`, and the selected scenario into a separate private disposable directory. Raw inputs contain 48 candidates in two repositories, including generated/vendor exclusions and missing inventory paths. Gamma is a separate available repository. Native probes must read the actual review instructions, preserve source bytes, and return reports in chat; fixture checks alone do not qualify model behavior or UI rendering.
